svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner, floor marking landing
svg.desc: Landing page first viewport: headline, primary actions, a top-down floor with a taped recommendation route, a printed move list, and the six-step flow as a floor walkway.
svg.text: Smart Warehouse Planner counts picks per part, finds parts
used on the same jobs, and recommends moves in rounds.
You apply, adjust or keep each one in place. Then print a
move list your colleagues can follow, round by round.
Demo on synthetic data · 2,000 locations · 1,545 parts · data as of 2026-09-30
to, a tick box per line
Every move names its rule, with a sign you can read without colour.
Shapes follow floor-signage grammar: square informs, triangle warns, circle forbids. The same signs appear on the map, the list and the print.
Fast-moving part into a best location:
24 or more picks in the period.
Slow-moving or dead stock out of a
Into its partner's aisle: two parts
on 5 or more of the same jobs.
You decline. Later runs and Apply
all leave the part where it is.
